assay: Total RNA (ribo-depleted) whole-transcriptome RNA-seq of peripheral blood leukocytes; mRNA, lncRNA, circRNA (and small-RNA library for miRNA, not deposited here)
inclusion: 4 male COPD patients, each sampled pre- and post-12-week personalized aerobic training (S2.1.p1, S2.2.p1, TAB1); 8 libraries
primary_estimand: Change in lncRNA expression in leukocytes of COPD patients after vs before 12 weeks of aerobic exercise training (post vs pre)
planned_contrasts: post-exercise vs pre-exercise, lncRNA (S3.2.p1; paper: 570 DE-lncRNAs, 271 up / 299 down)
paper_method: DESeq (2012) R package, two-group comparison post vs pre (pairing not stated); HTSeq counts for mRNA, Cufflinks for lncRNA, CIRI for circRNA (S2.4.p2)
